definitions.ask: When import links a new row to a subscription, should the row's payee be the record's title?
definitions.why: It is deterministic, and the record is the one place where a service is named

choices.label: The row reads as the record title; rename a service once, on its record
Your last hand-edited payee for that merchant wins; the title fills only new merchants
